samples.analysis:
A Google Chrome **Incognito** window is open to **yolokfx.com**, with the tab title beginning **“How to Get Free SHEIN Product…”**.

- The webpage has a black **YOLOKFX** header with navigation links: **HOME**, **FASHION**, **TRENDS**, and **CONTACT**, plus a search icon.
- The main article headline is **“How to Get Free SHEIN Products”**, followed by text about the official SHEIN reviewer program and product-testing opportunities.
- A prominent prompt reads **“One last question and we will show you how!”** with two green buttons: **Store pickup** and **Home delivery**.
- Below is a large **SHEIN** logo and an **OFFICIAL REVIEWER PROGRAM** badge. Article text explains that selected users may test products and that selection is **never guaranteed**.
- A bold section heading says **“🔥 THE MOST IMPORTANT STEP BEFORE APPLYING”** and advises keeping a SHEIN profile complete and updated.
- At the top of the content is an ad reading **“Claim your free ad credits”** with a red **GET OFFER** button.
- On the right is an age-selection ad for Lake Worth, FL with buttons **18–24**, **25–34**, **35–44**, **45–64**, **65–74**, and **75+**.
- The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom.
